summary: REQ-20 is only partially implemented: backend now initializes a default "contact" page and adds a migration, but the stored fields do not match the required header/body/footer mapping (address/phone/email). REQ-19 appears implemented in the footer (address/phone/email shown with tel:/mailto: links), but the diff for the Admissions page is truncated so the presence of the Address/Phone lines in the Contact Information card cannot be fully verified from the provided evidence. Additionally, adding backend/migration.mo conflicts with the constraint that all backend logic must remain in backend/main.mo.

missing_requirements.requirement: Default stored contact page must contain non-empty values for header (address), body (phone), and footer (email) matching the frontend default placeholders.
missing_requirements.reason: The default contact page in backend stores labeled/combined values instead of storing address/phone/email separately in header/body/footer. body contains both phone and email, and footer contains a non-email help sentence.

missing_requirements.requirement: On /admissions, the Contact Information card shows Address and Phone lines sourced from useContactContent() and does not hide them.
missing_requirements.reason: Admissions page diff is truncated before the contact card rendering; although it destructures { address, phone, email } from useContactContent(), the provided snippet does not include evidence that Address and Phone lines are actually rendered in the Contact Information card.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a separate backend migration module/file and wired it into the actor via (with migration = Migration.run).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints specify the backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; adding backend/migration.mo is additional backend logic outside main.mo and was not requested as a feature deliverable.

hallucinated_features.description: Added heuristic validation rules to suppress clickable mailto/tel links when strings contain placeholder-like patterns (e.g., email includes '[' or phone includes 'XXX').
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-19 only requires making phone/email clickable when non-empty; placeholder-pattern detection was not requested.
